leads.posting: Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team. Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. leads.posting: Team size: 5. AI-native agency that scales like software, run on our own AI agents. The Vibe Company (formerly Quivr, YC W24) is an AI-native agency. We build custom products and internal tools for companies, deploy agentic automations (agents, skills, workflows), and train teams on AI adoption. Our bet: agencies don’t scale because they sell hours. We’re building one that does, by automating our own internal processes with AI agents. Every workflow we automate for ourselves becomes something we can ship to clients. B2B, France, Europe, Remote, Partly Remote

AI Agency in Paris: Agents, Skills & Training | The Vibe Company Open to projects Paris We build your product, 10 to 20× faster. We build your products, we run agents inside your company, we train your teams. We run on AI ourselves, so you ship faster and for far less than a traditional team. We run on AI ourselves, so you ship faster and for far less than a traditional team. Book 30 minutes → See what we do 01 Build AI products and internal tools, end-to-end. 02 Operate Agents inside your company. Sales, support, admin, content. 03 Advise Strategy, training, and the AI playbook for your team. We work for them The work, in numbers Healthcare · Caregiver support 165 questions in a caregiver assessment that turns into a personal action plan Read the case → News · MediaGen (France 2030) 3 AI tools for newsrooms, within MediaGen, AFP's France 2030 generative AI project Read the case → Rentals · Customer support 87% of support tickets answered with our AI drafts Read the case → Food · CSR and quality 2 projects a CSR app for the teams, and AI skills for quality control Read the case → See all our case studies → // CLIENT WORK Built for clients, live in production. Healthcare · Caregiver support 165 questions in a caregiver assessment that turns into a personal action plan Monka supports people who care for a loved one, alongside coordinating nurses. To keep up with their growth, we shipped in two months the caregiver app, Lifeline, the CRM for their nurses, and the API that ties them together. → A caregiver app: a 165-question assessment that leads to an action plan, the circle of close ones, a chat with the nurse, and appointment booking. → Lifeline, the CRM for coordinating nurses: caregiver follow-up, agenda, conversations, questionnaires, and reports. → A versioned clinical engine that evolves the care framework (12 versions so far) without breaking the app. → A partner API with signed webhooks, so insurers can follow the people they cover. Read the case → News · MediaGen (France 2030) 3 AI tools for newsrooms, within MediaGen, AFP's France 2030 generative AI project With AFP, we're building MediaGen, a €4M France 2030 project backed by Bpifrance: trustworthy generative AI tools for newsrooms, always under journalists' control. We're part of the technical consortium alongside Kairntech and Dawex. → Augmented news monitoring: gather and analyze media, social networks, and press releases in real time. → Multimodal search: explore and make the most of text, photo, and video archives. → Content production help: turn one story into several formats and spot biases that could hurt its quality. Read the case → Rentals · Customer support 87% of support tickets answered with our AI drafts LocService handles several hundred support tickets a day. We read all their past tickets and internal docs to draft the answer for each new one, tailored to the customer's profile and history. → Connected to their internal APIs to pull real customer context. → Classification rules so the same question gets the right answer per customer type. → Hundreds of tickets a day, our drafts used on 87% of them. Read the case → Food · CSR and quality 2 projects a CSR app for the teams, and AI skills for quality control Coup de Pates supplies frozen products to food professionals. We built them Ensemble, the app that brings employees together around events like a step challenge, and a library of AI skills that checks their product documents. → Ensemble: an iOS and Android app to run internal life, launched with an inter-team step challenge. → Document control: AI skills that check a corrected label or specification against every annotation, and flag each gap. Read the case → Healthcare · Caregiver support 165 questions in a caregiver assessm

leads.title: AI & Robotics Trainer Internship
leads.posting: About Aven Robotics Aven Robotics is focused on empowering the next generation through hands-on learning in Artificial Intelligence, robotics, electronics, and emerging technologies. We deliver practical, project-based learning experiences that encourage students to explore, build, and innovate. We are looking for enthusiastic individuals passionate about technology, robotics, and teaching to join our team as AI & Robotics Trainer Interns. We will provide training before appointment in partner organisations. Roles & responsibilities Conduct hands-on training sessions in robotics, electronics, and related technologies. Teach students the fundamentals of Arduino, sensors, microcontrollers, and robotics kits. Guide students through practical projects involving automation, IoT, and basic robotics. Explain technical concepts through demonstrations and project-based activities. Assist in developing training materials, project guides, and learning resources. Conduct workshops and support school and institutional training programs. Help students troubleshoot hardware and software issues. Contribute to improving the quality of Aven Robotics training programs. Technical skills & expertise Arduino and Microcontrollers: Arduino Uno, basic circuit design, and interfacing. Electronics: Electronic components, breadboards, wiring, and circuit troubleshooting. Sensors & Actuators: Ultrasonic sensors, IR sensors, motors, and motor drivers. Robotics: Robotics kits, robot assembly, and automation projects. Programming: Basic C/C++, Python, or Arduino programming. IoT & Automation: Fundamental concepts and practical project experience. AI & Emerging Technologies: Basic understanding of AI and its applications in robotics. Teaching & Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and engage students. Knowledge of embedded systems, additional robotics platforms, or relevant technical projects will be an advantage. Eligibility criteria Students, graduates, engineers, and tech

leads.title: Junior Engineer (Typescript / Python / DevOps / AI)
leads.posting: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. Berlin, On-site Top-of-Market Compensation - Exceptional commitment deserves exceptional reward Most junior engineers take years to earn full ownership. Here as all our engineers, you will have real impact from week one and be a part of a team shipping a product millions of people use every day. Your first 12 months compress what takes 3 years elsewhere. You'll join a small team of engineers who have built and shipped at scale, with the support to learn fast. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more. We're looking for AI-native Junior Software Engineers who know how to build with AI tools, with different focus points, so you can pick your track: TypeScript (Backend or Frontend): If you love building things people see and use. You'll build features in our web and mobile apps, test what works with real users. You'll need: strong TypeScript understanding with a focus on either Node.Js or React.Js. Python (Backend): If you love building the systems behind the app. You'll build the services that handle rewards, offers, and payments for millions of users. You'll need: strong Python and SQL. DevOps: If you love building the tools that help everyone else ship. You'll build the CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and AI tooling our engineers use every day, and make them faster and safer. You'll need: strong TypeScript, Python, or Rust; Kubernetes or GitHub Actions is a plus. AI: If you love building with LLMs and want to see them work in production. You'll build AI features and automation that real users and teams rely on like AI-powered product features, internal agents. You'll need: Hands-on experience building with LLMs or ML models. What You’ll Do You'll own real problems from first idea to production. You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and take it further You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output. You dig into bugs until you find the real cause. What You'll Bring Solid fundamentals with proof of depth: projects you shipped,

leads.title: Software Engineer | Internship | Summer '27
leads.posting: About BlockTech BlockTech is a fast-paced algorithmic market maker facilitating global derivatives and spot trading, originating from crypto markets and expanding into new markets. We trade our own capital on systems that run 24/7 and have to be fast and correct without exception. Our systems run on Linux and are written in Rust and Python. For the Summer of 2027, we're looking for Software Engineer Interns to join our engineering team in Amsterdam. The role This is an 8-10 week summer internship at our Amsterdam office, giving you a unique opportunity to work on an end-to-end project with a real and direct business impact. You’ll work in a small team and get the chance to understand how a trading firm actually works from the inside. You will Participate in a customized training program that will give you an understanding of financial markets in general, the company and the project. Own a project from design to deployment guided by experienced software engineers. Work with production-level data and systems Learn from the best, all while leveraging cutting-edge technology What we're looking for Currently in your (pen)ultimate year studying computer science or a related discipline at a top university in Europe Available full-time in Amsterdam, for a duration of 8 - 10 weeks over the summer of 2027, starting with 5th of July Proficiency in a systems language (ideally Rust and/orC++) and working knowledge of Python A solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and what actually makes code fast A critical mind that follows things until completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English What's in it for you?
